purpose: ROADMAP §5.4 bullet 3 — freeze-day artefact committed to benchmarks/history/ per Ship-gate §5.4. Records the plan + code-level benchmark state at the moment all Claude-side Ship-gate items were closed and the doc-set awaited Gustavo's §11 / FREEZE §4 / CONTRACT §E signatures.

ship_gate_state.note: ROADMAP §5 itemised status at this snapshot (HEAD=052f580). Claude-side items split: executed-locally vs. CI-deferred (E2E PostgreSQL + behavior scenarios + soak + mutation require services / wall-time that only nightly CI runs before the tag). Property-test RUFF_CRITICAL_CLEAN was 7/8 at this snapshot (pre-existing emitted-template style issue, Wave-2 follow-up); remaining pre-freeze hardening is tracked in the Codex-audit commits landed under BLOCKER + HIGH + MEDIUM tags. Post-Codex-audit, the P0 validation sweep landed 4 additional commits (97c134c manifest/billing/catalog regression fixes, e44c568 stress .env fixture, 052f580 B1.6 perf 8x) — all three classes found by running the full test corpus end-to-end against HEAD. Gustavo-side ratifications still pending signature — they do NOT block test execution, only the tag cut.
